title: STREETOPIA: THE FILLMORE (BROOKLYN: BOOKLYN ARTISTS ALLIANCE, 2011)

web_text: Conceived by Erick Lyle and Marshall Weber, STREETOPIA is an assemblage of works by twenty-four current and former San Francisco artists associated with the art movements known as the Mission School and the New Mission School. Lyle traces the project's origins to a cement graffiti tag reading "Glitter Doll" that he encountered on Twenty-First Street near Capp Street in the Mission. He was soon imagining the stories behind other scratches and drawings that appear all over this ever-changing city. Each book in the variable edition of 30 is subtitled with the name of a different San Francisco neighborhood and features unique works of art.
